dedupe_keys.name: solar image based machine learning model for high speed stream prediction

description: SIML-HSS estimates Earth-arriving solar-wind speed from coronal-hole areas in solar images and a previous solar-rotation speed series. Regression and a distribution correction support forecasts of high-speed streams. The resource is documented by GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences, Potsdam, Germany. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The page says the model is not currently running in real time and excludes CME prediction. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
